statement:
∀ s r : ℝ, ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → KdVPlan.MemH r g →
 (∀ k, KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2 ≤ C^2*(KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖g k‖^2)) → KdVPlan.HB s f (C*KdVPlan.hn r g)
proof:
intro s r f g C hC hg h
have hw : ∀ s k, 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight s k := fun s k => Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
have hf : KdVPlan.MemH s f := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => mul_nonneg (hw s k) (sq_nonneg _)) h (hg.mul_left (C^2))
refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
unfold KdVPlan.hn
calc
 Real.sqrt (∑' k, KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2) ≤ Real.sqrt (∑' k, C^2*(KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖g k‖^2)) :=
  Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hf.tsum_le_tsum h (hg.mul_left (C^2)))
 _ = C * Real.sqrt (∑' k, KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖g k‖^2) := by rw [tsum_mul_left, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg C), Real.sqrt_sq hC]
